x-k-k5-01.title: Kutheni uJisu ephume emva kwexesha?
x-k-k5-01.goal: Khetha inkcazo ehambelana nazo zonke izibonakaliso kwincoko emfutshane malunga nesiganeko esadlulayo, uthi yeyiphi isibonakaliso esinobunzima obukhulu nokuba yintoni esengaqinisekanga.

Ingxoxo yeqela lokufunda (스터디 단체 대화방) ngosuku olulandela intlanganiso. UJisu ufike emva kwexesha kwaye akukho mntu wambuza ngokuthe ngqo ukuba kutheni.
민호: 어제 스터디에 지수 씨가 40분 늦게 왔어요.
하나: 맞아요. 처음에는 전화를 해도 안 받았어요.
민호: 도착했을 때 신발이 다 젖어 있었어요.
지수: 휴대폰이 꺼져서 연락을 못 했어요. 정말 죄송해요.
x-k-k5-01.thinking.0: Ukuqikelela isizathu esingachazwanga usebenzisa izibonakaliso ezininzi
x-k-k5-01.thinking.1: Ukuvavanya inkcazo nganye ngokuchasene nazo zonke izibonakaliso

x-k-k5-01.prereq.1: Uyayazi -아서/어서 kunye nokucela uxolo ngendlela ehloniphekileyo ye--요 efana ne-죄송해요
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi inkcazo yokufika kukaJisu emva kwexesha ehambelana nazo ZONKE izibonakaliso ezine (ukufika emva kwexesha, ukungaphenduli iminxeba, izihlangu ezimanzi, ifowuni icimile)?
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala izibonakaliso ezine, uze uvavanye inkcazo nganye ngokuchasene nazo zonke, hayi eyokuqala kuphela.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba zingaphi izibonakaliso ezine ezigutyungelwa yinkcazo nganye, uphawule ukuba zeziphi ezishiywa zingachazwanga.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.a: Ulale kakhulu, emva koko wakhawuleza waya kwikhefi engajongi ifowuni yakhe.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.a: Oku kuchaza ukuphuma kwexesha, kodwa akukho nto kuko echaza izicathulo ezimanzi. Hlola ingcaciso nganye ngokuchasene nomkhondo ngamnye.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.b: Wabanjwa yimvula endleleni, kwaye ifowuni yakhe yacima apho.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.b: Le ichaza ukulibala, izicathulo ezimanzi kunye neefowuni ezingaphendulwanga kunye. Incoko ayiboniseli mvula, kodwa libali elingashiyi mkhondo ungachazwanga.

x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba ifowuni yakhe yayicimile, akukho mntu wayenokumfumana ngefowuni, kwaye uxolisa ngokuphuma kwexesha, hayi ngokulibala.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.d: Wayengafuni ukuza, ngoko weza emva kwexesha ngabom waza wayeka iifowuni.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.d: Umbhalo ubonisa uxolo (정말 죄송해요) kunye nengxaki esebenzayo (ifowuni icimile). Akukho nto ikhomba ukuthanda ukuphepha intlanganiso.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.explain: Izicathulo ezimanzi kunye nefowuni eyacima zikhomba isiganeko esinye endleleni (imozulu okanye ingozi) echaza imikhondo emininzi ngaxeshanye. Imvula sisizathu esinokwenzeka kodwa asiboniswanga: ichibi okanye isiselo esiphalazekileyo nazo ziyahambelana.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.prompt: NgesiNgesi, chaza imikhondo EMIBINI exhasa ukhetho lwakho kakhulu, ucaphule isiKorea kwomnye ngamnye, uchaze ukuba kutheni ngamnye uyixhasa, uze uchaze enye into eyayinokwenzeka.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zibuze: yintoni enye enokwenza izicathulo zimanzi okanye ifowuni icime?
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba imikhondo yam emibini ivela kwincoko ngokwayo, hayi kuba ndicinga?
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba 'enye into enokwenzeka' yahlukile ngokwenene kuchazo lwam oluphambili?

x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.0: '신발이 다 젖어 있었어요' ibonisa ukuba wayephandle kwimozulu emanzi, kwaye '휴대폰이 꺼져서' ichaza ukuba kutheni angakwazanga ukuphendula iifowuni. Kunye zikhomba imvula nefowuni ecimileyo, kodwa ngekhe awele echibini, ngoko akuqinisekanga.

x-k-k5-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Imikhondo emibini eyahlukileyo nenye into eyahlukileyo eyenzekayo; zombini zivumelekile.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.2: Izicathulo ezimanzi (신발이 다 젖어 있었어요) kunye nefowuni ecimileyo (휴대폰이 꺼져서) ziyahambelana nebali lokufumana emanzi endleleni. Usenokuba wawela echibini endaweni yokubanjwa yimvula.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.3: Imikhondo eyomeleleyo: '신발이 다 젖어 있었어요' isixelela ukuba wayephandle kwimozulu emanzi, kwaye '휴대폰이 꺼져서' ichaza iifowuni ezingaphendulwanga. Enye into enokwenzeka: wawela echibini kwaye ifowuni yamanzi.

x-k-k5-06.title: Ukurhoxisa idinga neprofesa
x-k-k5-06.goal: Gqiba ukuba yintoni elahlekileyo kumyalezo wokurhoxisa obhalelwe umhlobo, uze uwubhale kwakhona kuprofesa.
x-k-k5-06.material:
Wawunedinga leyure yeofisi neprofesa wakho ngomso nge-3:00. Itheyibhile yeeklasi zakho itshintshe ngoku nje kwaye awukwazi ukuya. Uyilo lwakho lokuqala:
"교수님, 내일 3시에 못 가요. 다른 일이 있어요. 다음에 갈게요."

x-k-k5-06.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela ukhetho ngalunye ngamagama okwenene oyilo.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.a: Iprofesa ifumana imiyalezo emininzi kwaye ifuna ukwazi umthumeli nekhosi.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.b: Ixesha negama 내일 ziyabonisa ukuba lidinga liliphi; eli candelo loyilo lisebenza.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.c: '다음에' ayicacanga kakhulu ukuba iprofesa icwangcise ngayo.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.o.d: Lisebenzisa ixesha elidlulileyo kwinto yexesha elizayo

x-k-k5-06.s.s1.explain: Uyilo luchaza idinga kodwa hayi umbhali, aluxoli naphi kwaye lushiya inyathelo elilandelayo livulekile. Ixesha lilungile kwaye ixesha licacile.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.acc.0: Umfundi usenokuvakalelwa kukuba ukuxolisa kumalunga nesimbo hayi umxholo; umthumeli nexesha elitsha zisezona zithuba eziyimfuneko.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.prompt: Phinda ubhale umyalezo kuprofesa ngesiKorea: zazise kunye neklasi yakho, xolisa, unike isizathu esifutshane, uze ucebise ixesha elitsha. Sebenzisa iziphelo ezisemthethweni, ezinembeko.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.hint.0: Cwangcisa iinxalenye ezine: ndingubani, uxolo, isizathu, ixesha elitsha.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha iziphelo ze--ㅂ니다 okanye -세요 ngalo lonke.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba iprofesa ingaphendula 'ewe' ngaphandle komnye umbuzo?
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ixesha elitsha liyacaca (usuku nexesha losuku)?
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba zonke iziphelo zam ziyahlala zisemthethweni?
